project_identity.name: Graph-Based Financial Crime Detection Engine
project_identity.tone: Dark Forensics, Cybersecurity, Elite Intelligence, Trusted Authority
project_identity.core_philosophy: Data is beautiful, but crime is ugly. Reveal the ugly truth with beautiful data.

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL headings, numbers, and data values.
Use Inter ONLY for long-form text and UI labels.
Uppercase all labels (e.g., 'TRANSACTION ID', 'RISK SCORE') with tracking-widest.
No generic 'Sans-Serif' fallbacks if possible; stick to the stack.

containers.card: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm px-6 py-2 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm px-6 py-2 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)]
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm px-6 py-2 transition-all

cards.forensics: relative bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-none p-6 hover:border-zinc-600 transition-colors group
cards.stat: flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/50 rounded-sm

inputs.search: bg-zinc-900 border-b border-zinc-700 focus:border-blue-500 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono py-2 px-4 outline-none transition-colors w-full rounded-none

assets.icons: Lucide React (e.g., ShieldAlert, Network, Search, Activity, Lock, Database, FileUp)

image_urls.description: Abstract purple/blue network grid for subtle texture overlays.
Deep space network nodes for hero background.

libraries: react-force-graph-3d (CRITICAL: Must use for main graph)
papaparse (For CSV parsing on frontend if needed, or send to backend)

implementation_notes.graph: Use `ForceGraph3D` for the main visualization. Nodes should be spheres. Edges should be lines. Use auto-coloring based on 'risk_score' (Red=High, Amber=Medium, Blue=Low). Add glow effects using custom node rendering if possible, or just emissive materials.
implementation_notes.csv_upload: Use a drag-and-drop zone. Show a progress bar styled like a hacking tool (text-based progress).
implementation_notes.data_handling: Ensure the graph can handle 10k nodes. If performance lags, switch `react-force-graph-3d` to static mode or reduce particle count.

universal_guidelines: NO EMOJIS. This is a serious crime detection tool. Use icons (Lucide) instead.
Dark Mode ONLY. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
Performance First: The graph must be smooth. Use WebGL.
Data Density: Don't waste space. Use compact tables and grids.
Feedback: Every action (upload, analyze, click) must have immediate visual feedback (loading spinners, toast notifications).
Interactive Graph: Clicking a node must open a 'Suspect Profile' side panel or modal.
